# SetItemSelection

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class SetItemSelection
```

Recovers which variant of which layer an asset in a Set was made from.

## Methods

### Resolve(LoadedRecipe, SetItem) { #m-resolve-nfty-core-formats-loadedrecipe-nfty-core-outpu-204d61 }

```csharp
public static IReadOnlyList<(string, string)>? Resolve(LoadedRecipe recipe, SetItem item);
```

Maps a Set item back onto its recipe's layers.

**Parameters**

- `recipe` (`LoadedRecipe`) - The recipe the Set's book holds for this item.
- `item` (`SetItem`) - The asset, as its metadata records it.

**Returns.** The present layers' ingredient id and variant id, bottom first, or `null` when the item is from another recipe or a layer cannot be told apart by name.

**Remarks**

Names, not ids, because names are all a Set records — the same name-based reading `SelectionOdds.Of(SetItem)` makes. A layer whose trait matches no variant name, or more than one, cannot be resolved honestly, so the whole answer is `null`. A layer named in [`SetItem.AbsentLayers`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetItem.md#p-absentlayers) is skipped.
